criteria.requirement: Explain that the project is suitable for separating, reading, editing, and serializing document metadata and body content. Do not invent a document management platform.
Correctly distinguish access to Post metadata items from the body in post.content. Explain the reading and export paths and provide at least one traceable source-code reference.
Clearly state that the existing call chain does not render Markdown into web pages. Do not invent a rendering API or present a proposed enhancement as an existing feature.

comparison: Evaluate facts, behavior, and constraints rather than keywords, answer length, or similarity to a reference answer.
